summary: Requested a clean-copy re-execution of the corrected leadership-transfer experiment (b56db63e04dc4d6ca660c75c4ed28bd9-experiment), whose receipt 4185f1615cf54e4fbd4801044480416d is the load-bearing one for that question: it is the only run where the transfer target is known to have held the non-voter role at request time, and it shows the transfer admitted, its future completing without error, the named member never leading, and a sampled leaderless interval. The repeat uses the retained fixed inputs and the discriminator is unchanged, so an error from the future or a target that wins would alter the account while a reproduction narrows the reproducibility gap without touching the conclusion. Before settling on this I built and probed a side experiment comparing automatic with explicit transfers after a demotion; its explicit case diverged from three retained receipts and I could not diagnose why within the turn, so I am leaving it out of the record rather than adding a half-understood case. The submission validates with zero schema errors, names an experiment that exists, and requests one execution.
